title: Folder naming
$comment: Draft v0. Follows docs/stages/K2-observe.md, step 'Naming folders without a usable info file' (decisions 30, 39, 40, 42). One folder_namer call looks at images drawn at random from the folder and returns this object. Names produced here carry origin generated.

folder_name_fits.description: Whether the folder name fits what the sampled images show, judged by the model.

info_file_fits.description: Whether the names of the folder's info file fit what the sampled images show; null when the folder has no info file.

images_consistent.description: False when the sampled images show unrelated subjects; the sync report then flags the folder (decision 42).

name.description: Code applies K0 token trimming, then refuses blank names and names containing the configured knowledge.concept_separator; the trimmed name is used throughout.
